one step before wall distance positive 0.258, about to cross into wall

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.0313 to 0.005 (single field change) while keeping steps same; with finer integration wall collision is resolved without penetration, so violation disappears.

explanation: Large dt (~0.031) with high speed (~22.6) causes substep collision handling to fail: body tunnels/penetrates wall by 0.29 > 0.15 tolerance at step 33. With smaller dt the trajectory is resolved correctly, showing numerical integration / CCD failure at large dt.
vision_note: The red body travels rightward just above the top edge of the grey wall across steps 30-32. At step 33 it is visibly intersecting/overlapping the top-right corner of the wall instead of deflecting or sliding along it.
